module: Livery editor routes (Vue): list (liveries), edit (liveries.edit), paint (liveries.edit.paint) and decals (includes the decals module). Hooks: ui_liveries_routeLifecycleCallbacks.onLiveriesEnter / onLiveriesEditEnter / onLiveriesPaintEnter / onLiveriesLeave / onLiveriesRootLeave.
notes: Route configuration module: it exports no function. routeManager reads it (via the ui_router_routes_<name> extension) when routes.lua includes it with `{ include = "<name>" }`.
The keys of `Children` form the segments of the dotted name: "<module>.<child>". `children` (lowercase) in a node designates its sub-routes; `include` mounts another module there.
`ui` is inherited by child routes (uiTypes, uiTypesFilter, infoBar, topBar, uiApps, uiNav, triggerPause): a child redefines it only for what changes.

Root.desc: {screenId = "liveries", title = "ui.liveries.title", Vue only, default infoBar, topBar hidden, onEnter onLiveriesEnter, onLeave onLiveriesRootLeave}

Children.desc: edit (backTarget liveries; children paint and decals = include of the decals module).

ModuleName.desc: Name of the routes module (first segment of the dotted name).
